issues.description: The problem statement and UML expect a Stock method named addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), but the template's Stock class provides addItem(StockIngredient) instead. The solution implements addToStockIngredients. This naming mismatch will confuse students and cause compilation errors if they implement SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery according to the specification (which expects to call addToStockIngredients).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Stock API match the problem statement and solution by renaming addItem(StockIngredient) to addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), or add a new addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient) wrapper that delegates to addItem. This ensures students can implement SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery exactly as specified without compilation issues.
